title: Five physics closures and three outside-box probes: matrix-valued Wilson pumping, an extended Hawking lattice, microscopic channel-balance RG, an autonomous scar gadget, curvature finite-size scaling, a geometric phase transistor, a causal-entropy bound, and a synthetic monopole
purpose: Execute the five physics targets following Passes 4113-4120 and add three independent outside-box constructions with deterministic finite-model checks and strict evidence boundaries.
result: A six-dimensional SU(3)-singlet contraction space produced a rank-two Wilczek-Zee bundle with noncommuting Wilson loops and commutator trace -1/4. A nine-cell 38-dimensional paraunitary Hawking chain resolved greybody loss, partner localization, entanglement, stability, and an ultraviolet counterpropagating branch. Four microscopic Markov channels derived the channel-balance scale flow and selected deterministic spectral dimension four. A 25-state engineered static history clock executed a 24-gate local SWAP program with exact data and full-history revivals. Product thermodynamic curvature scaled exactly as 1/N and a positive one-dimensional transfer matrix excluded a finite-temperature singularity. Three outside-box probes produced a geometric phase-order transistor, a Levi-cut causal-entropy throughput bound, and spin-one Chern bands (-2,0,2) carrying synthetic charge two.
coordination: Passes 4005-4136, the single-publisher master:/docs Pages contract, and the authoritative long-form docs/index.html remain intact. A concurrency-safe reconciler places this packet after 4129-4136 when the active parallel packet publishes; docs/index.html is never edited directly.
boundary: Exact finite singlet-multiplicity, Gaussian-scattering, Markov, history-clock, transfer-matrix, circuit-entropy, and band-topology statements only. No continuum QCD, fabricated non-Abelian pump, observed Hawking radiation, derivation of physical spacetime, thermodynamic phase transition, non-Abelian anyon, black-hole entropy law, physical magnetic monopole, gravity, cosmology, or theory of everything is established.
